description: Parse the webpack module stats file (.next/stats.json) and link it to a build loaded with load_build_stats. Unlocks the stats-powered tools: suggest_optimizations (enriched), find_duplicates, explain_shared_chunks, and trace_import.

buildId.description: Build ID returned by load_build_stats; the stats.json is read from that build directory

name: load_webpack_stats
title: Load Webpack Stats
